name: ignition
vibe: T-minus and holding: a launch pad at night on a deep space-blue ground — a 60-tick countdown ring depletes while mono T-minus digits step down, telemetry bars fill in the margin, a dotted trajectory arc climbs with a tiny vessel, stars drift down as exhaust embers rise, and every scene change is a launch wipe of vertical thruster streaks. Headlines slam in on a countdown cadence and the key word sits inside a HUD target-lock. Built for product launches, releases, countdowns and reveal films — the ember accent re-tints to any brand color.
